CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL($User.TimeZoneSidKey, 'Europe/London'), ExpirationDate >= DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(ExpirationDate))) & "-03-21 00:00:00"), ExpirationDate < DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(ExpirationDate))) & "-10-27 00:00:00") ), ExpirationDate - (1/24), ExpirationDate )
CustomField.label: Expiration Date
